title: The Iron Hand
summary: Gregor rigged the Tithe lot for five years so that Elena's name never came up, and this year it did. His frantic week of bribes, roads, substitutes and begging, and what he is when it strips him down: a coward or a father.

flags.ih_trail_opened: Questions about who rigged the lot began to lead to Gregor's shop, his back room and the strongbox key in his coat pocket
flags.ih_file_traced: Bjorn said the recut tile had been worked with a fine file of the kind Gregor's shop sells
flags.ih_ransom_offered: Gregor begged the messenger to carry his strongbox, his shop and his steel to the men in the forest as a ransom for Elena
flags.ih_ransom_dangled: Mira told Gregor, weeping, that the men in the forest would think on his ransom
flags.ih_road_laid: Gregor laid a road east before Elena at their own table: a wagon, a Kingsroad carter and a physician in the Capitol
flags.ih_elena_refused_the_road: Elena told her father at their own table that she would take no road east, whatever it cost
flags.ih_kingsroad_watched: Varn put a man on the Kingsroad to watch for a merchant's wagon leaving Thornhaven
flags.ih_drifter_bought: Gregor pressed coin into the hand of a drifter sleeping rough at the old mill, for a body in the Hollow's cart
flags.ih_fenn_again: Gregor stood outside the Fenns' door after dark with a spare lot tile in his hand
flags.ih_relot_refused: Elder Mathias refused Gregor's plea to draw the lot again 'to be sure', and kept the urn locked
flags.ih_messenger_begged: Gregor begged Mira, as the messenger, to carry word to the men in the forest: take the father, not the daughter
flags.ih_ledger_begged: Gregor begged the stranger to give back his ledger of rigged draws, and offered anything for it
flags.ih_ledger_to_the_council: Elder Mathias read Gregor's ledger of rigged draws aloud before the council, year by year and name by name
flags.ih_gregor_offered_bargain: Gregor offered the stranger his strongbox and the Hollow's delivery nights in exchange for silence until the cart had gone
flags.ih_varn_ultimatum: Varn sent word to Gregor that if he talked, his daughter would never see where the cart went
flags.ih_bargain_accepted: The stranger took Gregor's bargain: his strongbox and the Hollow's delivery nights, for silence until the cart had gone
flags.ih_gregor_denounced: The stranger refused Gregor's bargain and named him before the council as the man who rigged five years of the Tithe lot
flags.ih_hearing_called: Elder Mathias called the council to hear Gregor in the hall before anyone touched a rope
flags.ih_last_order_placed: Gregor placed the Hollow's autumn order at Bjorn's forge as if nothing had changed
flags.ih_steel_routed_round: Mira had the Hollow's steel ordered through a Kingsroad carter, around Gregor's shop
flags.ih_supply_line_cut: The Hollow's supply line through Gregor's shop was cut, and no more of Bjorn's steel or Gregor's grain went up to the forest
flags.ih_rope_brought: Neighbours brought a rope to the square for Gregor, with the Fenns and the Brands at the front
flags.ih_shop_door_held: Captain Aldric stood in Gregor's shop door and told the square there would be no hanging in Thornhaven
flags.ih_elena_before_the_rope: Elena stood between her father and the square and said the families would have to go through her
flags.ih_ledger_read_aloud: Gregor knelt in the square and read his ledger aloud: every year, every tile, every name, and Hesk Marlow's as his own choosing
flags.ih_stood_before_the_rope: The stranger stood between Gregor and the village's rope and made Thornhaven hear him instead
flags.ih_left_him_to_the_village: The stranger stepped back and left Gregor to the village
flags.ih_gregor_fled: Gregor fled Thornhaven by night with his ledger in his coat, leaving his shop dark, his daughter's name still on the lot and the village's rope behind him
flags.ih_hue_raised: Captain Aldric rode out along the Kingsroad after the runaway merchant
flags.ih_kingsroad_hunted: Varn's men rode the Kingsroad after the runaway merchant
flags.ih_let_him_run: The stranger learned which road Gregor had fled by, let him go, and raised no hue and cry behind him
flags.ih_at_the_tailboard: Gregor stood at the cart's tailboard on Collection Night in boots shod for stone, waiting for one word to climb in
flags.ih_ledger_given: Gregor put his ledger and his strongbox key into the stranger's hand at the gate on Collection Night
flags.ih_heard_his_last_word: The stranger heard the last of Gregor's confession at the cart's tailboard on Collection Night
flags.ih_paid_for_nights: Gregor emptied half his strongbox into the messenger's hands to buy Thornhaven more nights before the cart
flags.ih_paid_varn_for_nights: Gregor sent coin up the forest path to Varn himself, behind the messenger's back, to buy more nights before the cart

beats.title: The Strongbox
beats.summary: In Gregor's back room sit a strongbox and a ledger. The strongbox holds a second set of the chapel's lot tiles and a packet of white salt; the ledger holds five years of rigged draws.

hooks.situation: The whole village is talking about a recut tile. Your duplicates are in the strongbox and your ledger is on the shelf behind the flour. You have never managed to burn it.

options.label: Sleep with the strongbox key round his neck and the back room barred

effects.text: Keep the stranger out of the back room with talk of prices and a hand on their arm.

options.label: Hold the ledger over the stove and fail, again, to burn it

effects.text: Tell the stranger, between you and me, that a man keeps some things so that one day someone will make him stop.

hooks.situation: Everyone knows now the tile was recut. You know more: the cut was made with a fine file, the kind Gregor sells by the dozen.

options.label: Tell the stranger the file was the kind Gregor's shop sells

effects.text: Tell the stranger the recut was made with a fine file, the kind Gregor's shop sells. He says it to their face.

options.label: Keep it to himself; half the valley owns such a file

hooks.situation: If the rigged lot comes out, the trail must stop at Gregor. But a hanged merchant cannot be your leash this week.

options.label: Let slip that Gregor never takes his coat off in the chapel

effects.text: Whisper to the stranger, eyes on the door, that Gregor touches his coat pocket every time the urn is mentioned.

options.label: Keep him useful a little longer

hooks.situation: You found the spares in that strongbox this summer. If the stranger finds them, they will know what your father did for five years.

options.label: Tell the stranger, if they ask, that the strongbox holds only coin

effects.text: If the stranger asks about her father's strongbox, say it holds coin and receipts. Change the subject.

options.label: Say nothing and let the stranger look

beats.title: Five Doors
beats.summary: Gregor's frantic week. He tries every door at once: a bribe, a road east, a substitute, the messenger, and at last himself. Every door opens onto someone who wants something else.

hooks.situation: The second morning. Everything you own is for sale. The messenger can carry an offer to the men in the forest.

options.label: Beg Mira to carry his strongbox, his shop and his steel to the men

effects.text: Gregor begged her to carry his offer to the men: the strongbox, the shop, double steel. Anything for Elena.

options.label: Press the Elder, behind the council's back, for the undercroft fund

effects.text: Gregor came to him privately and begged for the undercroft fund as Elena's ransom. He offered to repay it threefold.

hooks.situation: Gregor has offered you everything to carry to 'the men'. You are the men.

options.label: Weep and say the men will think on it

effects.text: Mira wept and said the men will think on it. Wait. Do nothing that might anger them.

options.label: Say the men want the girl, not coin

effects.text: Mira said it through tears: the men don't want coin. They want the girl. She's so sorry. She only carries it.

hooks.situation: The third day. A wagon, a mule, a Kingsroad carter who owes you, a physician in the Capitol who already has your coin.

options.label: Lay the road east before Elena at their own table

effects.text: Her father laid out a road east at supper tonight: a wagon, a carter, a physician. He begged.

options.label: Buy the carter's silence first and tell her after

effects.text: Ask the stranger whether they know a Kingsroad carter who can keep his mouth shut for good coin.

hooks.situation: Your father has laid a road east before you at your mother's table, with his voice breaking. It is exactly what you were afraid he would do.

options.label: Refuse it plainly

effects.text: Tell the stranger she told her father no at their own table. He wept. She will not take any road east.

options.label: Pretend to consider it, to spare him one night

effects.text: Elena said she would think about the road east. She would not meet his eye.

hooks.situation: Your man in the village says the merchant is talking to Kingsroad carters.

options.label: Post a man on the Kingsroad

effects.text: A carter came back pale: there's a Hollow man sitting by the Kingsroad milestone, whittling, watching wagons.

options.label: Let him try; it would be a pleasure

hooks.situation: The fourth day. The men want a body in the cart. It need not be hers. You are ashamed of how fast you thought of it.

options.label: Press coin into a drifter's hand at the old mill
Stand outside the Fenns' door after dark with a spare tile
Beg the Elder to draw the lot again 'to be sure'

effects.text: Gregor begged him to draw the lot again, to be sure the gods meant it. His hands were shaking.

hooks.situation: You followed your father into the dark. He is standing outside the Fenns' door with a spare tile in his hand. Ada is fourteen.

options.label: Take the tile out of his hand

effects.text: Elena took the spare out of his hand outside the Fenns' door and said: not her. Not anyone. Never again.

options.label: Run for the stranger

effects.text: Find the stranger tonight: her father is outside the Fenns' door with a spare tile. Please. Stop him.

hooks.situation: Word has reached you that Gregor is buying a drifter for the cart, and asking about a second draw.

options.label: Refuse any name but the lot's, and keep the urn locked

effects.text: The Elder sent word: there will be no second draw and no bought name. The lot is the lot.

options.label: Say nothing

hooks.situation: The fifth day. The messenger is the only road to the men. She has always been kind. Beg her.

options.label: Beg Mira to carry word: take the father, not the daughter

effects.text: Gregor knelt in her kitchen and begged her to tell the men: take the father, not the daughter.

options.label: Beg Mira to ask the men who changed his tile

effects.text: Gregor begged her to ask the men who changed his tile, and why they put Elena's name in his hand.

hooks.situation: Gregor has knelt in your kitchen and offered himself. A father who will do anything.

options.label: Weep, promise, and carry nothing

effects.text: Mira held his hands and promised to carry it. She'll tell him what the men say. She is so sorry.

options.label: Carry it to Varn, to see what he does with an offered merchant

effects.text: The widow passed it on, level: the merchant offers himself for the girl. She wants to hear what you think of that.

hooks.situation: The sixth day. Every door has shut. One is left, and it is in your own boots.

options.label: Tell the stranger that if anyone climbs into the cart, it will be him

effects.text: Tell the stranger: if anyone climbs into that cart, it will be him. He is not sure his legs will do it.

options.label: Sit with the ledger in the back room and read the names

hooks.situation: The High Magistry has summoned you east to testify, with your ledger. Six days from the Capitol, in Tithe week.

options.label: Burn the summons; he cannot leave her this week

effects.text: Tell the stranger the Magistry can wait. He is not leaving Thornhaven while that cart is coming.

options.label: Think of riding east, ledger and all

hooks.situation: Elena has gone from the house of her own accord.

options.label: Hope, for the first time this week
Fear what the men will do now

effects.text: Beg the stranger to find out where Elena went. If the men hear she's gone, they'll want another name.

hooks.situation: The stranger has sworn to stand at the gate with Aldric's six. Six farmers need more nights than the Hollow has given them. Nights can be bought. Everything can be bought.

options.label: Empty half the strongbox into the messenger's hands, for nights

effects.text: Gregor begged her to carry half his strongbox to the men, for more nights before the cart. Anything for Elena.

options.label: Send the coin to Varn himself, behind the messenger's back

effects.text: Tell the stranger, trembling, that he has paid the Hollow's lieutenant for more nights, and the messenger must not know.

options.label: Keep the coin for the wagon east

hooks.situation: Gregor has put half his strongbox in your hands to buy the village nights before the cart. You are the men, and the nights are yours to sell.

options.label: Take the coin and hold the cart a night, so he knows coin still works

effects.reason: The Boss took Gregor's coin and held the cart a night, so he would know coin still worked.

effects.text: Mira says the men took the coin, and the cart will wait one night. She cried carrying it.

options.label: Take the coin and let the night stand

effects.text: Mira says the men took the coin and said nothing. She is so sorry. She only carries it.

hooks.situation: The merchant sent coin to you, not to the Boss, to buy nights before the cart. He has chosen a master. The question is whether you let her see it.

options.label: Take it and hold the cart a night, behind the Boss's back

effects.reason: Varn took Gregor's coin behind the Boss's back and walked the cart down a night late.

options.label: Take it and tell the widow the merchant went round her

effects.text: Varn's word: the merchant sent coin up the path to him, not to you. Varn kept it.

beats.title: Whose Names
beats.summary: The ledger in Gregor's hand: each autumn, the tile he palmed and the neighbour it fell to, beside his deliveries to the Hollow. Corin Ashby, Davin, Hesk Marlow, Willa Brand, and this year Ada Fenn.

hooks.situation: Your ledger is gone from the shelf. Somebody has read five names in your hand.

options.label: Beg the stranger for the ledger back, and offer anything

effects.text: Beg the stranger for the ledger. Name it. Coin, a horse, a debt forgiven. Not until the cart is gone.

options.label: Let them keep it; part of him kept it so that someone would stop him

effects.text: Tell the stranger, very quietly, that he is almost glad someone finally read it.

hooks.situation: The stranger has Gregor's ledger. If the rigging comes out, Gregor must hang for all five years and the trail must stop at him.

options.label: Let the well hear that the stranger found Gregor's ledger
Hold it back; a hanged merchant cannot feed the leash

hooks.situation: The stranger has given you the ledger. Five years of names in Gregor's hand. You suspected him for a year and could never prove it.

options.label: Lay the ledger before the council, with the stranger as witness

effects.text: Tell the stranger he put the ledger before the council. Evidence, not gossip.

options.label: Hold it until after Collection Night; a mob makes a second cart

effects.text: Tell the stranger he will hold the ledger until the cart is gone. A mob on Tithe week makes a second cart.

hooks.situation: The lot you blessed for five years was rigged, and here is the hand that rigged it: the son of the man who once paid a widow's surety.

options.label: Give Gregor one day to come to the council of his own will

effects.text: The Elder sent word: come to the council of your own will by tomorrow's dusk. The door is open until then.

options.label: Read the ledger aloud before the council, name by name

hooks.situation: The stranger has shown you the ledger. Every name that went instead of you, in your father's hand. You knew. Seeing it is different.

options.label: Ask the stranger to let her father answer for it to the families' faces, not the well

effects.text: Ask the stranger: if her father must answer for those names, let it be to the families' faces. Not at the well.

options.label: Read every name in it, slowly

beats.title: Cornered
beats.summary: The stranger has confronted Gregor. Under the bargaining are two men: a coward who runs or sells another child, and a father who tells the truth. He does not know yet which one he is.

hooks.situation: The stranger knows. The tiles, the names, the salt. Elena's cart comes on Collection Night. Everything you have is in your hands, and your hands are shaking.

options.label: Confess everything: the spares, the palmed tiles, the four names, and Hesk as his own choosing

effects.text: Tell the stranger all of it, the way it really was. 'She was thirteen. You didn't hear her breathing.'

options.label: Offer the stranger his strongbox and the Hollow's delivery nights for silence

effects.text: Between you and me: the strongbox, and the nights the Hollow's men come for steel. Only silence until the cart is gone.

options.label: Run tonight, with the ledger in his coat

hooks.situation: You have said the names aloud. One thing is left: why. The white salt in the strongbox, every night in her tea.

options.label: Tell the stranger about the white salt that keeps her alive

effects.text: Tell the stranger about the white salt. Without it the fever takes her within a season. That was the price.

options.label: Keep the salt's source back

hooks.situation: You are in the back-room doorway and the stranger is facing your father. He is about to lie, or run, or break.

options.label: Step in, take his hand, and say she has known since summer

effects.text: Elena took his hand in front of the stranger and said she has known since the summer, and that she doesn't hate him.

options.label: Stay out of sight

hooks.situation: Your man says the stranger has been in the merchant's back room. A frightened merchant talks.

options.label: Send word: talk, and the girl never sees where the cart goes

effects.text: Varn's word came through the back door: talk, and your girl never sees where the cart goes. Never.

options.label: Leave it to the widow

hooks.situation: Gregor has been cornered. Whatever he said, it is on its way to the well, or it is not.

options.label: Let the well hear his confession

effects.via: a weeping widow at the well

options.label: Comfort him as the messenger, and keep him

effects.text: Mira came with soup and sat with him. She said she knows what it is to be trapped. She only carries messages.

beats.title: The Last Order
beats.summary: Bjorn's steel still goes up to the Hollow through Gregor's orders: the other half of the salt's price. This autumn's order is on the forge peg.

hooks.situation: The Hollow's autumn order is due at the forge: twice the swords a village could sell. Steel is the other half of the salt's price.

options.label: Place the order as if nothing had changed; steel is the other half of the salt's price

effects.text: Gregor came with the autumn order, smiling too much: forty blades, the usual travellers.

options.label: Cancel the order himself

hooks.situation: You know now where your steel has been going: up the forest path, to the men who walk children up a ridge.

options.label: Refuse the order and say why to Gregor's face

effects.text: Tell the stranger he refused Gregor's order to his face. Not one more blade goes up that path.

options.label: Forge it, and spoil every blade at the anvil

effects.text: Tell the stranger the Hollow will get its blades. They'll snap at the first blow. He'll own it after.

options.label: Forge it as always; Gregor's orders paid his father's debt

hooks.situation: Your boy poured the spare tiles in this forge, for Gregor's coin. The Hollow's order is still on the peg.

options.label: Melt the order down in front of the stranger

effects.text: Tell the stranger he melted the Hollow's order down. Davin poured those spares in this forge.

options.label: Leave it on the peg; he cannot think yet

hooks.situation: Gregor has placed another order at the forge. Forty blades, for 'travellers'. You have suspected him for a year.

options.label: Seize the order at the forge door before it leaves

effects.text: Tell the stranger the forty blades are his six's now. Gregor's travellers can whistle for them.

options.label: Let it go, and follow it to the mill

effects.text: Ask the stranger to come with him to the old mill tonight and watch where Gregor's steel goes.

hooks.situation: Questions are leading to Gregor's shop. If the steel keeps going through him, it goes down with him.

options.label: Route the steel through a Kingsroad carter, around Gregor
Let the merchant carry it; the trail stays on him

hooks.situation: The autumn steel is late. You want it for the night the Hollow changes hands.

options.label: Send a man to the back door to ask why

effects.text: A Hollow man came to the back door after dark and asked, softly, where the autumn steel was.

options.label: Let it slide; there is other steel

hooks.situation: The blades that went up the path this autumn will break at the first blow. You made sure of it.

options.label: Tell the stranger he did it, and will own it

effects.text: Tell the stranger every Hollow blade from his forge this autumn will snap. He did it and he'll own it.

options.label: Say nothing, and hammer

beats.title: His Bargain
beats.summary: Gregor has offered the stranger his strongbox and the Hollow's delivery nights for silence until the cart has gone. The stranger must take it or name him.

hooks.situation: You have made your offer. The stranger has not answered. You keep glancing toward the chapel.

options.label: Press for an answer before the seventh night

effects.text: Press the stranger for an answer. Quotes prices nobody asked for. 'A father does what he must.'

options.label: Wait, and stroke his beard

hooks.situation: Gregor is trying to buy the stranger's silence. If the rigging comes out on his terms, the trail may not stop at him.

options.label: Let the council hear, in tears, that Gregor rigged the lot
Let him bargain; a frightened merchant is her best leash

hooks.situation: The stranger has the Hollow's delivery nights from Gregor. The men come to the old mill for steel.

options.label: Take the six to the old mill on the next delivery night
Refuse to act on the word of a man who sold children

effects.text: Tell the stranger he won't build a plan on Gregor's word. The man sold four children.

hooks.situation: The stranger has named Gregor before the council. The families will want a rope by nightfall.

options.label: Call the council to hear him in the hall, not the square
Say nothing

hooks.situation: The stranger has named your father before the council.

options.label: Stand at her father's side before the council

effects.text: Tell the stranger she is standing at her father's side. He answers to the families' faces, with her beside him.

options.label: Tell the council the last tile was her own hand

effects.text: Tell the council and the stranger that this year's tile was her own hand. Her father didn't put her in the cart.

beats.title: Named Before the Council
beats.summary: The stranger named Gregor before the council. By nightfall all Thornhaven knows whose children went in Elena's place.

hooks.situation: The stranger has named you. The whole village knows.

options.label: Go to the families' doors before they come to his

effects.text: Tell the stranger he is going to the Ashbys', the Marlows' and the Brands' doors tonight, before they come to his.

options.label: Bar the shop and sit in the dark with the strongbox

hooks.situation: Gregor. Your tiles. Your boy.

options.label: Go and hear it from his own mouth

effects.text: Tell the stranger he is going to hear it from Gregor's own mouth before anyone puts a rope on him.

options.label: Stand with the families

beats.title: The Rope
beats.summary: Thornhaven knows. The families of the taken stand in the square with a rope, and Gregor stands in his shop door. The stranger must stand between them, or step back.

hooks.situation: The rigged lot is out. Gregor must hang for all five years, and the trail must stop at his neck.

options.label: Stand with the Fenns and the Brands and say it softly: five years
Weep in her doorway and do nothing

hooks.situation: The square is full. Corin Ashby's mother is at the front. Willa Brand's father has the rope. Your shop door is at your back.

options.label: Run tonight
Kneel in the square and read his ledger aloud, every name, Hesk as his own
Beg for one week, until after the cart

effects.text: Beg the stranger to ask the square for one week. Let them hang him after the cart, only not before.

hooks.situation: A rope in the square in Tithe week. The lot you blessed was rigged, and now the village wants a second death to answer for it.

options.label: Call the council to hear him first
Let the families have their say

hooks.situation: Someone has brought a rope. A mob does not make justice; it only makes one more family to mourn.

options.label: Stand in Gregor's shop door: no hanging in Thornhaven
Step aside; he answers to them

hooks.situation: Thornhaven is under your command. Whatever happens to Gregor happens under your law.

options.label: Tell the square that under his law there is no rope

effects.text: Tell the stranger there'll be no rope under his command. Gregor answers to a hearing, after the cart.

options.label: Leave the families their grief

hooks.situation: They have come for your father. Every name in his ledger is a family in this square.

options.label: Stand between her father and the square
Go to the families herself, one by one

effects.text: Tell the stranger she went to every family's door herself. She'll carry it with him. She told them so.

hooks.situation: Gregor is in his doorway. You cast those tiles. Your boy poured the spares.

options.label: Face him first, man to man, before the rope

effects.text: Tell the stranger he means to face Gregor before anyone else does. Man to man. Then the village can have what's left.

options.label: Stand with the families

hooks.situation: Gregor has stood on every doorstep his draws robbed, and told Hesk Marlow's widow before you that Hesk was his choosing.

options.label: Tell the square what he did

effects.text: Tell the stranger Gregor knocked on every door, and said Hesk was his own choosing, before the widow and the Elder both.

options.label: Keep it for the hearing

beats.title: The Empty Shop
beats.summary: Gregor is gone in the night with his ledger in his coat. The shop is dark, Elena's name is still on the lot, and the stranger has to decide whether to let him run.

hooks.situation: Your father is gone. The shop is dark. Your name is still on the lot.

options.label: Open the shop herself in the morning

effects.text: Tell the stranger she opened the shop this morning. Somebody has to sell the valley its candles.

options.label: Let it stay dark

hooks.situation: Gregor has fled. Whatever he knows of the Hollow is riding east with him.

options.label: Ride after him on the Kingsroad
Let him go; the six are needed at the gate

hooks.situation: The merchant ran. The Hollow's salt, its steel and its hand in the urn, all on the Kingsroad.

options.label: Send men along the Kingsroad after him
Let him run; the girl is the leash now

hooks.situation: Gregor ran. A runaway is the end of every trail.

options.label: Let every whisper end at the runaway
Say nothing

hooks.situation: Gregor is gone. His last order is still on your peg.

options.label: Melt the last order

effects.text: Tell the stranger he melted Gregor's last order. That's done, at least.

options.label: Sit a while in the dark shop

beats.title: The Tailboard
beats.summary: Collection Night. Gregor stands at the cart's tailboard in boots shod for stone. Whatever happens at the gate, he has one last thing to say, and he says it to the stranger.

hooks.situation: The cart is at the gate. Your daughter is somewhere behind you. Every door you knocked on this week has shut. Except one.

options.label: Stand at the tailboard in ridge boots, waiting for one word to climb in
Put his ledger and his strongbox key into the stranger's hand
Beg Varn one last time

effects.text: The merchant came to the tailboard with his strongbox key held out. Name it, he said. Anything.

hooks.situation: The shop is written over to Elena. The messenger has carried your word. The boots are laced.

options.label: Stand steady
Shake, and hate himself for it

hooks.situation: Your father is at the cart's tailboard in ridge boots. It is the thing you were most afraid he would do.

options.label: Pull him down by his coat

effects.text: Elena pulled him down off the tailboard by his coat and said: it's my name. It was always my name.

options.label: Let him choose, as she chose

effects.text: Tell the stranger she let her father choose, the way she chose. She could not take that from him too.

hooks.situation: The merchant is at your tailboard offering himself.

options.label: Laugh: an old merchant is a poor digger and a poorer hostage

effects.text: Tell the stranger an old merchant is a poor digger and a poorer hostage. The girl is worth ten of him.

options.label: Shrug: one is one

effects.text: Tell the stranger the Hollow isn't particular. One is one.

hooks.situation: Gregor is at the tailboard. You wrote 'choose' on a slip once, to see how deep he would go. Now you know.

options.label: Whisper that the men will take him

effects.text: Mira whispered at his shoulder, weeping: the men will take you. I asked. I'm so sorry.

options.label: Watch

hooks.situation: Gregor has put his ledger in the stranger's hand at the gate.

options.label: Ask to read it to the council after the cart

effects.text: Ask the stranger to bring Gregor's ledger to the council after tonight. Every name read aloud.

options.label: Pray for the man

endings.title: The Father's Climb
endings.summary: Gregor told the stranger the last of it at the tailboard and climbed into the cart in his daughter's place. Of the two men he might have been, he was the father.

endings.title: The Runaway
endings.summary: Gregor ran with his ledger in his coat, and the stranger let him. Of the two men he might have been, he was the coward.

endings.title: The Honest Hour
endings.summary: The stranger stood between Gregor and the rope, and he answered for the five rigged draws to the families' faces, alive.

endings.title: The Rope
endings.summary: The stranger stepped back and Thornhaven took Gregor for what his rigged lot had cost it.
